stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon begins rolling out in Gemini app and Antigravity, but only if you pay
stories.originalTitle: Gemini 4 Argon begins rolling out in Gemini app and Antigravity, but only if you pay
stories.summary: Google revealed Gemini 4 Argon a few weeks ago, saying that it needed to move cautiously toward a full release because of the potential for nefarious use. Google seems to have worked all that out pretty quickly, though. Argon is beginning its wide rollout toda
points: Google revealed Gemini 4 Argon a few weeks ago, saying that it needed to move cautiously toward a full release because of the potential for nefarious use.
Google seems to have worked all that out pretty quickly, though.
Argon is beginning its wide rollout today , but it's only coming to paying users at this time, and even those on lower-tier plans won't have full access.

stories.summary: AI agents increasingly need to access web resources that are priced per request. For example, premium datasets charge by the query, research APIs meter by the call, and paywalled publishers gate content behind payment. When an AI agent encounters one of these
points: AI agents increasingly need to access web resources that are priced per request.
For example, premium datasets charge by the query, research APIs meter by the call, and paywalled publishers gate content behind payment.
When an AI agent encounters one of these resources, the server returns HTTP 402 Payment Required.
